nom: medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm

segments.combination: One 34-year-old combination-skin reviewer with large pores and volume/elasticity loss reports visible improvement in fullness around the eyes and neck.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s report mixed results for smile lines and under-eyes, with several seeing plumping over weeks and others (mid-30s) seeing no change despite daily use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers use this for fine lines, smile lines, sunken under-eyes and loss of volume; several in their 30s report fuller lips, filled-in smile lines and plumper under-eyes after 2-8 weeks of consistent use, while others (also 30s) report no visible difference after a month or more of daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe it as hydrating and moisture-retentive, though one warns it mainly locks in hydration without delivering the promised volumizing effect.

aspects.libelle: Slow to absorb, sits on skin
Pills under other skincare or makeup
Requires weeks of consistent use to see effect

extraits.texte: all this stick might be good for is locking in hydration and providing your under-eye area with milia. using it lightly every so often may give you more moisture retention, but it certainly didnt work for me to help fill in the bags under my eyes, or to "volufill" areas on my face. if you dont like greasy film sitting on your face, this product also wont be for you. id image this product may work a bit more in the way of "filling" you out if youre in your early 20's, but I would still be cautious with overuse. It was easy to apply too much and have it absolutely pill every other skincare product I was using on my face. would not buy again, kinda regretting getting one as I dont need another moisturizing in my makeup bag.

this is a skip! the hype was all great marketing with influencers saying their skin felt like they had gotten filler. its not hard to have plump and perfect skin when youre in your early 20's. as a mid 30's woman, this was a pass for me, ive been using every day for over a month and see absolutely no difference. the one pro is that its hydrating. save your money and invest it towards something with less incentivized reviews.

I have been using this product for 3 weeks. I put it on at night, before bed and in the morning after I shower. I rub it in before applying makeup. It does not effect the makeup going on as usual. It is lightweight, not too greasy. I see a slight difference so far, but hoping it will eventually improve the skin under my eyes that is dark and sunken in.

extraits.titre: I'm 38 and it's working for me
extraits.texte: I didn't buy it from Ulta, but i will now to avoid shipping! I love this product, ive been using it for two months, twice a day. My biggest issue are my under eyes are sunken in and i have deep smile lines. After two months using this, there IS A NOTICEABLE DIFFERENCE. Consistency is key. I promise. Yes is it a bit greasy feeling, sure but its minimal. I dont wear much face makeup so its a glow (along with my serum and moisturizer) My smile likes are sooo much fuller and not deep. My under eyes are filling out. I frickin love this and ive bought two more. Give it some time, it can work for you!

The best way to use volufiline. It takes a few weeks, thats just the nature of the way volufiline works but this gave me my top lip back and no more dark undereyes. I use it 2x daily around my eyes and in my lines and all day long on my lips like chapstick. Its not magic, people.

extraits.titre: I wish I was paid for this review
extraits.texte: I work for Ulta so I saw this product being shelved and i LOVE Medicube's pink line. Im 34 i have fine lines, large pores on my nose, between my eyebrows, and a bit on my cheeks. Combination skin AND a lit of volume and elasticity loss from losing weight. I work in the salon, a guest came to us asking for recommendations for volume loss and crepeing under here eyes. She pointed right at me and said "YOU LOOK BEAUTIFUL WHAT DO YOU USE?!" Like. Girl omgosh. Thank you. This. I used this stick halphhazzardly before bed because i almost forgot. Then i used it yesterday before work. And it made such a noticeable difference a stranger clocked it??? Buy it. I especially really really really feel a lot better about my neck skin. Weight loss really had me ready to cry. This stick will be in my kit for as long as they make it 🥹

I don't understand the negative reviews on this products, unless it was meant for the wrinkle bounce stick, which does absolutely nothing, or they really didn't have any lines to plump to begin with. For me, this balm does wonders making the skina around my mouth and eyes appear fuller and fresher.
